description: This file defines the SlidePreference class, a custom Android preference component that includes a SeekBar for selecting a value within a range, with associated UI elements for displaying current, min, and max values. It is part of a pixel keyboard app, providing a slider-based preference setting.

classes.name: SlidePreference
classes.description: A custom Android preference component with a SeekBar for selecting a value within a specified range, displaying current, min, and max values, and supporting persistence.

methods.name: SlidePreference
methods.description: Constructor initializing the preference with context and attribute set, reading custom attributes.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds the preference view holder, initializes UI elements, and sets up the SeekBar.

methods.name: onSetInitialValue
methods.description: Initializes the preference value, restoring persisted value if available.

methods.name: onProgressChanged
methods.description: Handles SeekBar progress changes, updates the value, persists it, and updates UI.

methods.name: onStartTrackingTouch
methods.description: Empty implementation for SeekBar touch start event.

methods.name: onStopTrackingTouch
methods.description: Empty implementation for SeekBar touch stop event.

methods.name: writeBoundaries
methods.description: Updates the UI labels for min and max boundaries and current value.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the slider (for testing).

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the slider (for testing).
